plan.businessDomain: Hiring pipeline management for job positions and candidate applications.

entities.title: Candidate
entities.description: A person registered or attached as a candidate for job applications in the hiring pipeline.

entities.title: Candidate Contact Channel
entities.description: A contact channel linked to a candidate, including the email used to identify and communicate with the candidate.

entities.title: Hiring Manager
entities.description: A person responsible for a job position and authorized to decide its offers and hiring outcomes.

entities.title: Job Position
entities.description: An approved hiring need opened for applications, with a responsible hiring manager and a defined headcount.

entities.title: Application
entities.description: A candidate's application to a job position, progressed through screening, interview, offer, hiring, or rejection.

relationships.description: A candidate has one or more contact channels, including the email used for identification and communication.
Each job position is assigned to one responsible hiring manager, who decides offers and hiring outcomes.
Each application belongs to the candidate who applied for the position.
Each application is submitted for one job position.

entities.title: Candidate
entities.description: A person registered or attached as a candidate for job applications in the hiring pipeline.

contactChannels.title: Candidate contact channels
contactChannels.description: Contact channels linked to the candidate through the platform HasContact relationship, including the email used for identification and communication.
contactChannels.required: When the candidate is registered or attached for recruiting

applications.title: Candidate applications
applications.description: Hiring applications that belong to this candidate.
applications.required: When an application is recorded for the candidate

capabilities.read.byId: Reads a candidate master record by its MDM identifier through the indexed record lookup for recruiters and hiring managers reviewing an application.
capabilities.locate.byName: Finds candidates by typed name through the Person name index for recruiters registering or selecting a candidate.
capabilities.locate.byDocument: Finds a candidate by national document during create-or-attach deduplication for recruiters.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the candidate owning an email or other contact channel for recruiters before registration and when starting an application.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates a Person record when absent or attaches the existing person to the Candidate role by document or contact lookup for recruiters registering candidates.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Updates platform-owned candidate identification data through the master-record update route for recruiters maintaining candidate information.
capabilities.edit.moduleNamespace: Updates the hiringPipeline recruitment source in the candidate module namespace for recruiters maintaining recruitment information.
capabilities.inactivate: Inactivates or reactivates a candidate master record through the platform status action for recruiters when the record should no longer be used.
capabilities.link.contact: Creates or links a ContactChannel through HasContact so the candidate has an email for identification and communication, used by recruiters.
capabilities.listLinks: Lists the candidate's contact-channel and application-related links through the relationship service for recruiters and hiring managers reviewing the candidate.
capabilities.attach.document: Stores and retrieves the candidate's resume as a platform-managed attachment by category for recruiters and hiring managers reviewing qualifications.
capabilities.audit: Shows the platform audit trail of candidate master-data changes for authorized recruiters and hiring managers.

subtype.title: Record subtype

name.title: Candidate name

values.title: Merged

values.title: Blocked
values.description: The record is blocked by the platform.

status.title: Master record status
status.description: Platform status that determines whether the candidate master record is active.

docType.description: National document type, when supplied to deduplicate the candidate.

docId.description: National document number, when supplied to deduplicate the candidate.
docId.title: Document number

countryCode.description: Country that governs the candidate's document and applicable privacy rules.
countryCode.title: Country code

identification.description: Platform identification data used to recognize and maintain the candidate.

contacts.description: Platform-derived summaries of contact channels linked to the candidate, including the email used for identification and communication.
contacts.title: Contact channels

base.description: Platform-managed base data used by the hiring pipeline.

person.description: Platform person data; the hiring pipeline does not require additional person fields for a candidate.

source.title: Recruitment source
source.description: How the candidate was sourced for recruitment, such as a referral, job board, agency, or careers site.

entities.title: Candidate Contact Channel
entities.description: A contact channel linked to a candidate, including the email used to identify and communicate with the candidate.

candidate.title: Candidate owner
candidate.description: The candidate who owns this email contact channel through the platform HasContact relationship.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads a candidate email contact channel by its master-data id through indexed retrieval for recruiters and hiring managers viewing candidate information.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the contact channel that owns a supplied email through the platform contact lookup so recruiters can avoid registering the same candidate email twice.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates an email contact channel when absent or attaches the hiringPipeline candidate-contact role when it already exists, using the email value, for recruiters registering candidates.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Updates the platform-owned name or email contact data for an active candidate contact channel through the master-data update route for recruiters maintaining candidate records.
capabilities.inactivate: Inactivates or reactivates a candidate email contact channel through its platform status for recruiters when the email must no longer be used.
capabilities.link: Links a candidate contact channel to its candidate with the versioned HasContact relationship for recruiters registering or maintaining candidates.
capabilities.unlink: Closes the candidate-to-contact HasContact relationship while preserving its history for recruiters correcting a candidate record.
capabilities.listLinks: Lists the candidate relationship and its validity for a candidate contact channel on candidate record screens used by recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.audit: Shows the platform audit trail of changes to a candidate email contact channel for authorized hiring-pipeline administrators.

entities.title: Hiring Manager
entities.description: A person responsible for a job position and authorized to decide its offers and hiring outcomes.

jobPositions.title: Job positions managed
jobPositions.description: Job positions for which this hiring manager is the responsible decision-maker for offers and hiring outcomes.
jobPositions.required: Never; a hiring manager may be registered before being assigned to a job position.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads a hiring manager by known master-record id through the MDM index and document store for recruiters and hiring managers viewing a responsible manager.
capabilities.locate.byName: Finds a hiring manager by typed name through the Person name index for recruiters assigning a manager to a job position.
capabilities.locate.byTag: Lists people carrying the hiringPipeline.HiringManager role tag through the indexed MDM tag lookup for recruiters choosing an eligible hiring manager.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates a Person when absent or attaches the Hiring Manager role to the existing person through document or contact matching for recruiters setting up position responsibility.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Updates platform-owned identification data through the MDM person update route for recruiters maintaining a hiring manager record.
capabilities.inactivate: Inactivates or reactivates the hiring-manager master record through the platform status operation for recruiters when the person must no longer be assigned to positions.
capabilities.statusHistory.read: Shows master-record status changes through MDM status history for recruiters reviewing whether a hiring manager is active.
capabilities.audit: Shows who changed the hiring-manager master record and when through the MDM audit log for recruiters investigating record maintenance.

details.description: Platform person record read by the hiring pipeline for a person who manages job positions.

subtype.description: Platform-derived subtype identifying this master record as a person.
subtype.title: Record subtype

name.description: Name used by recruiters to identify the hiring manager when assigning responsibility for a job position.
name.title: Name

values.title: Merged
values.description: The record was merged into another person.

status.title: Status
status.description: Platform-derived master-record status that indicates whether this hiring manager can be used.

identification.description: Platform identification data used to recognize the hiring manager.

base.description: Platform base data for the person; no base fields are specific to the hiring-manager role.

entities.title: Job Position
entities.description: An approved hiring need opened for applications, with a responsible hiring manager and a defined headcount.

hiringManager.title: Responsible hiring manager
hiringManager.description: The hiring manager assigned to this position and authorized to decide offers and hiring outcomes.
hiringManager.required: when the job position is opened

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The applications submitted for this job position.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads a job position by its row id so recruiters and hiring managers can review its hiring need.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists job positions by indexed status or responsible hiring manager so recruiters find open positions and hiring managers find positions they manage.
capabilities.locate.byText: Finds job positions by text in the indexed title so recruiters can locate a position by name.
capabilities.count: Counts job positions matching a status or responsible hiring manager filter for hiring pipeline lists.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists job positions for a responsible hiring manager through the hiring manager foreign key.
capabilities.create: Creates an open job position with its title, department, description, headcount, and responsible hiring manager when a recruiter opens a hiring need.
capabilities.update: Updates the maintained details of an open job position when a recruiter needs to correct its hiring need information.
capabilities.transition: Moves an open job position to closed through the automatic filled-headcount process.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the responsible hiring manager master record from the hiring manager foreign key for position review and decision scope.

title.title: Job title
title.description: The title used to identify the job position in lists and searches.

hiringManagerId.title: Responsible hiring manager
hiringManagerId.description: The hiring manager responsible for offers and hiring decisions for this position.

values.title: Open
values.description: The position is available for applications.

values.title: Closed
values.description: The position is closed after its headcount is filled.

status.title: Position status
status.description: Whether the job position is open for applications or closed because its headcount has been filled.

details.title: Job position details
details.description: The descriptive information and hiring need for this job position.

department.title: Department
department.description: The department requesting this job position.

description.title: Position description
description.description: The responsibilities and requirements of the job position.

headcount.title: Headcount
headcount.description: The number of candidates to hire for this position.

filledHeadcount.title: Filled headcount
filledHeadcount.description: The number of applications for this position that are in the hired stage.

remainingHeadcount.title: Remaining headcount
remainingHeadcount.description: The job position headcount minus the number of applications for this position that are in the hired stage.

transitions.description: Close the job position automatically when the required headcount has been hired.

entities.title: Application
entities.description: A candidate's application to a job position, progressed through screening, interview, offer, hiring, or rejection.

candidate.title: Applicant
candidate.description: The candidate who submitted this application.

jobPosition.title: Applied-for job position
jobPosition.description: The job position for which this application was submitted.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads one application by its id so recruiters and hiring managers can review its candidate, position, and stage.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists applications by indexed candidate, job position, or stage so recruiters and hiring managers can find the applications they are responsible for.
capabilities.count: Counts applications matching indexed filters so the module can determine how many candidates have been hired for a job position.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists applications for a candidate or job position through its foreign key so the related record screen can show its applications.
capabilities.create: Creates an application in screening for a candidate and an open job position when a recruiter starts screening.
capabilities.transition: Moves an application through screening, interview, offer, hired, or rejected under the transition rules and the authorized actor.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Prevents a candidate from having more than one application for the same job position using the candidate and job-position key.
capabilities.transaction: Atomically records a hire and closes the job position when that hire fills its required headcount.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the master candidate record referenced by an application so recruiters and hiring managers can view the candidate's name and available resume.

jobPositionId.title: Job position
jobPositionId.description: The job position to which the candidate is applying.

values.title: Screening
values.description: The recruiter is screening the application.

values.title: Interview
values.description: The candidate has advanced to interview.

values.title: Offer
values.description: The hiring manager has approved making an offer.

values.title: Hired
values.description: The candidate has been hired for the job position.

values.title: Rejected
values.description: The application has been declined with a recorded reason.

status.title: Application stage
status.description: The current stage of the candidate's application.

details.title: Application details
details.description: Information recorded specifically for this application.

transitions.description: Advance a screened application to interview.
Approve an offer for an interviewed candidate in a position managed by the hiring manager.
Hire an offered candidate while the job position still has hiring capacity.
Reject an application and record the reason it will not proceed.

relationships.description: A candidate has one or more contact channels, including the email used for identification and communication.
Each job position is assigned to one responsible hiring manager, who decides offers and hiring outcomes.
Each application belongs to the candidate who applied for the position.
Each application is submitted for one job position.
